context_requirements: No specific target or pathway is defined for this heterogeneous class; a response would require the particular inhibitor to engage a phospholipase-dependent transcriptional program in the cell line.
falsifiers: A reproducible, concentration-dependent and cell-line-selective transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h that is shared across multiple chemically distinct phospholipase inhibitors would contradict the prediction of no expected response.
Recovery of a known phospholipase-dependent gene program (e.g., eicosanoid or lysophospholipid-responsive genes) in these lines would contradict the hypothesis.
